short_description: Israel-based LinkedIn strategist, trainer, speaker and author, best known for his book Build a LinkedIn Profile for Business Success and for teaching professionals, founders and B2B sales teams how to use LinkedIn as a business-development platform. Advises international clients across Europe, including DACH founders and B2B teams, and has appeared as a guest on Startuprad.io and adjacent DACH founder-focused podcasts on the topic of LinkedIn for early-stage companies.
